leaders.does: Splits a sound into transient and sustain with complementary gating envelopes, low or zero latency with an optional 5 ms lookahead; Sensitivity, Mode, Hold and Release set the detector, a sidechain can drive it; each half gets saturation, bounce, diffusion and delay with its own level, mix and tilt, or its own mixer track; a scrolling display shows the input with the two envelopes in different colours; themes from the gear menu

Attack and Sustain sliders per band, up to three bands with Learn for the crossovers, Sharp, Medium or Smooth contour per band, Precise, Balanced and Loose modes, a Mix, bypass and solo per band, and a scrolling gain trace over the incoming waveform; undo history in the host plugin
Divides a sound into transients and sustain, with one horizontal Balance fader from transients to sustain and three focus modes: bass, highs or full band

picture.note: The family line: the last notes along time, each one's own hit as a solid mark and its body as a span, with an arc from each body back to the note it came from. No leader draws where a sustain came from, because none moves one. Under Transmitter in one way: it draws notes from the meters, not the waveform itself.

precision.note: Every setting is a kit value: dragged, nudged, typed, reset with a double-click. Hit and Fade in whole milliseconds, Threshold to a tenth of a dB.

compare.note: Undo, redo and A/B from the kit; Neutron has undo history, Transmitter states neither.

explains.note: Every setting has an about, shown in the foot; the note under the name says how far back the body comes from and into which half.

fits.note: Scales whole and fills any window; three densities.

character.note: The house look; arcs and hits turn purple with the setting that shapes them.

presets.note: Four of its own, each for a use: a line one note late, a slower inheritance two back, the old ring in the sides, and drums passing bodies on. Transmitter's page lists none.

tools.tube: It colours nothing: it moves a sound's body in time, with no valve in it
